newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz says Gavazzi to leave board.
newsitem.headline: Allianz says Gavazzi to leave board.

text.p: German insurer Allianz AG Holding said on Tuesday that Roberto Gavazzi had decided to step down from its management board on June 30, and would leave the company for a position in Italy.
Allianz also said in a statement that it had appointed head office director Helmut Perlet as deputy member of the management board as of July 1.
Gavazzi, 57, is currently responsible for west European business on Allianz's seven-member management board.
Allianz says Gavazzi to leave board=2
An Allianz spokesman said Gavazzi had decided to leave his position "for personal reasons", not because of friction over strategy, as had been speculated in the Italian press.
Gavazzi joined the Allianz board in 1994.
Allianz also said it planned to create an new international executive committee as part of its management structure.
This will comprise top managers from the largest Allianz companies in Italy, France, Britain, Austria, Switzerland, the U.S. and Singapore.
The statement was released during a meeting of Allianz's supervisory board ahead of its annual press conference on Wednesday.
